sources.title: CoreWeave — Q3 2026 earnings call transcript
sources.source_unit: Management remarks; forward-looking statements remain expectations
sources.excerpt: We will not use the unsecured debt market to fund our business at current yields. ... We expect to finance the majority of the remaining CapEx needed to deliver our backlog through delayed draw term loans matched to specific customer contracts. ... In the next three months alone, we will collect approximately $9 billion in prepayments and deposits from signed customer contracts.

sources.title: Nebius Group — Q3 2026 earnings call transcript
sources.source_unit: Management remarks; forward-looking statements remain expectations
sources.excerpt: The prepayments on new contracts now cover more than 100% of the capital needed to bring this contracted capacity online. ... Some of our colocation sites, including New Jersey, are behind schedule. Customers have been kept informed, and none of that capacity is canceled. Some of it has shifted to 2027.

sources.title: IREN — Q1 FY2027 earnings call transcript
sources.source_unit: Management remarks; forward-looking statements remain expectations
sources.excerpt: In July, we said more than $4 billion of operating ARR was targeted to be online by year-end. It's now January. ... A customer asked for a design change ... And two, supplier timing. ... If suppliers deliver, we're targeting January. If they're late ... it may run to the end of February.

sources.title: Applied Digital — Q1 FY2027 earnings call transcript
sources.source_unit: Management remarks; forward-looking statements remain expectations
sources.excerpt: The full 400 MW of the CoreWeave campus at Polaris Forge 1 and the 200 MW of contracted capacity at Polaris Forge 2 are now fully funded. ... The next campuses we need to finance are Polaris Forge 3, Delta Forge 1, and Delta Forge 2. ... Our HPC Hosting Business generated $262.6 million of revenue, consisting of $65.8 million of base rent, $183.5 million of tenant fit-out services, and $13.3 million of tenant recoveries.

sources.title: Hut 8 — Q3 2026 earnings call transcript
sources.source_unit: Management remarks; forward-looking statements remain expectations
sources.excerpt: The balance sheet requires an important distinction between corporate liquidity and project-restricted capital. ... The restricted balances are principally proceeds from the River Bend and Beacon Point financings, held in project accounts for construction, debt service reserves, and other specified project purposes. They are not excess corporate cash. ... Those obligations sit at project subsidiaries ... and are non-recourse to Hut 8's parent company.

sources.title: TeraWulf — Q3 2026 earnings call transcript
sources.source_unit: Management remarks; forward-looking statements remain expectations
sources.excerpt: We already have the equity required to fund the project. Google's credit support materially strengthens the financing profile and we fully expect to fund the remaining capital requirement with project-level debt ... The definitive EPC agreement covers all three data center buildings ... We do not own the GPUs.
